verdict.rationale: ClickUp's developer docs say an OpenAPI spec exists 'for each version of our Public API', which implies a versioned API. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning scheme details, deprecation notice/sunset timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The raw OpenAPI specification for the ClickUp API is available for each version of our Public API.
